metadataRaw.title: How to Fix Hip Pain at Night (Do This Before Bed!)
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows how to instantly relieve hip pain and discomfort at night.

This is usually caused by a buildup of muscle tightness and tension that develops throughout the day. If this tightness isn’t released before going to bed, it may continue to worsen, leading to increased pain and disrupted sleep.

To address this, the video goes over simple exercises to help quickly release tension and strengthen the muscles that support the hips for both immediate and long-lasting relief.

Each exercise works differently and is designed to be done in bed—even in the middle of the night. For best results, go through all of them and use the ones that provide the most relief.

Watch now to relieve your hip pain at night and start sleeping better!
